name: ct5-thread-valve-dark
js: (() => { const k=[...document.querySelectorAll('.codingthread .gateseat .btn')].find(b=>/Keep planning/.test(b.textContent||'')); k && k.click(); return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); })()

name: ct6-thread-unit-dark
js: (() => { const k=[...document.querySelectorAll('.codingthread .gateseat .btn')].find(b=>/Keep planning/.test(b.textContent||'')); k && k.click(); return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>{ const b=document.querySelector('.hgate.coding .btn.primary'); b && b.click(); setTimeout(()=>{ const m=document.querySelector('.codingthread .convomsgs'); if (m) m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight; setTimeout(r,500); },900); },700)); })()
